title: Clone Conspiracy #4 #5 Lot Marvel 2017 Dead No More Dell'Otto Covers Dan Slott
condition_description: #4 bright and clean. #5 has a short vertical crease at top center of the front cover through the title. See photos.
description:
Lot of 2: Dead No More: The Clone Conspiracy #4 and #5 (2017), Marvel Comics - the last two issues of the Amazing Spider-Man event. Written by Dan Slott, art by Jim Cheung; painted covers by Gabriele Dell'Otto (#4 Spider-Man vs. the Lizard). Direct editions, $3.99 cover price each.

Back covers: both M&M's 75th Anniversary Marvel Custom ads (Fantastic Four #1 homage).

Condition:
- #4: bright and clean with light handling wear.
- #5: short vertical crease at the top center of the front cover through the title; otherwise bright.

See photos. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
